description: Layout v2 retired the top/bottom table form of rune.ui.layout. A stale table must be rejected with a migration notice that leaves the default layout active and never aborts the rest of init.lua, so every registration below the old call still loads.

scenarios.name: a v1 layout table prints a migration notice and the script continues

steps.expect_printed: top/bottom layout tables are no longer supported

steps.note: the statement after the rejected call still ran
